_meta.about: Every string of the macOS menu bar app and the Windows tray app. English text first, then vi and zh. {name} style placeholders are filled by the app. The app picks the language from the system and falls back to en. Wording follows the manage page (web/manage/src/i18n).
_meta.plural: menu.phones.none / .one / .other: pick by count (0, 1, anything else). The other keys have no plural forms.

en.app.name: Nookdeck
en.menu.quit.hint: Quitting this app does not stop Nookdeck. Your phone keeps working.
en.pair.title: Pair a phone
en.pair.scan: Scan the QR code or enter the PIN on a phone to pair.
en.pair.scan.wifi: Scan the QR code or open the link on a phone on the same Wi-Fi network.
en.pair.scan.tailscale: Scan the QR code or open the link on a phone signed in to the same Tailscale network.
en.pair.error: Could not get a pairing code. Make sure Nookdeck is running.
en.pair.notRunning: Nookdeck is stopped. Start it to pair a phone.
en.setup.adopted: Found your existing Nookdeck and kept its settings and phones.
en.setup.ready: Nookdeck is ready. Pair your phone from the menu.
en.update.restartNeeded: Nookdeck will restart to finish the update.
en.perm.accessibility: Nookdeck needs Accessibility permission to press keys for you.
en.firewall.ask: To let phones on your network connect, Windows will ask you to allow Nookdeck through the firewall.
en.error.setupFailed: Nookdeck could not finish setting up: {error}
en.error.updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection.
en.error.loginItemFailed: Could not change Open at login: {error}
